subject: English
passage:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
• In 2023, Stanford University researchers discovered hydrothermal vents in the Mariana Trench.
• A hydrothermal vent is an underwater opening that releases heated water from beneath the Earth's crust.
• The water temperature around these vents can reach 400°C (752°F).
• The extreme heat of this water makes it lethal to most marine organisms.
• Some forms of extremophile bacteria are able to thrive near hydrothermal vents.
prompt: The student wants to explain why hydrothermal vents are lethal to most marine organisms. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?

choices.A: Though hydrothermal vents are lethal to most marine organisms, some extremophile bacteria can thrive there.
choices.B: The water around hydrothermal vents is lethal to most marine organisms because it can reach temperatures of 400°C (752°F).
choices.C: The hydrothermal vents in the Mariana Trench are lethal to most marine organisms and were discovered by researchers in 2023.
choices.D: Hydrothermal vents are heated underwater openings that release water from beneath the Earth's crust.

explanation:
Choice B is the best answer. The sentence explains why hydrothermal vents are lethal to most marine organisms, noting that the water around the vents can reach temperatures of 400°C (752°F).

Why D is incorrect:

Choice D is incorrect because the sentence describes hydrothermal vents, mentioning that they release heated water, but doesn't explain why they are lethal to most marine organisms.
